declaration.preface:
Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP is committed to minimizing its environmental impact and supporting sustainable development through responsible environmental management and continual improvement. As a manufacturer of speciality chemicals, the Company recognizes that its operations have environmental aspects and impacts and therefore strives to prevent pollution, conserve natural resources, and comply with all applicable environmental laws and regulatory requirements.

This Environmental Policy establishes the framework for Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP’s environmental objectives and targets, defines governance and accountability mechanisms, and outlines key initiatives to enhance environmental performance across all business operations. The Policy guides employees, contractors, and relevant stakeholders in promoting environmental stewardship and integrating sustainability principles into day-to-day activities.
declaration.declaration: Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP declares its commitment to protecting the environment by preventing pollution, complying with all applicable environmental laws and regulations, and continuously improving its environmental performance. The Company shall responsibly manage resources, control emissions and effluents, minimize waste, and integrate environmental considerations into operational and business decisions, while promoting awareness and accountability among employees and relevant stakeholders.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Policy applies to all operations of Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP, including chemical manufacturing, storage, utilities, and supporting functions, carried out at its location. It addresses environmental aspects related to resource consumption, emissions, effluents, waste management, and chemical handling, and extends to all employees, contractors, and service providers operating on behalf of Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP.

Energy Consumption & GHGs: Install variable frequency drives (VFDs) on motors, pumps and replace conventional lighting with LEDs where feasible.
Conduct Bi-annual energy audits and optimize boiler, chiller, and HVAC efficiency to reduce consumption.
Utilize waste heat recovery from existing processes to lower energy use and GHG emissions.
Air Pollution: Maintain the efficiency scrubbers, filters, and ventilation systems in manufacturing and utilities to control emissions.
Monitor stack emissions and ambient air quality regularly to ensure compliance with local regulations.
Minimize emissions from internal operations and transport through process optimization, proper chemical handling, maintenance, and efficient vehicle usage.
Materials & Waste: Optimize raw material usage by improving process efficiency and minimizing scrap.
Reuse packaging materials within existing in-house systems.
Ensure proper segregation, storage, and disposal of hazardous waste via authorized vendors.
Water: Reduce freshwater consumption through efficient use and process optimization.
Maintain and optimize existing water reuse and recycling systems to maximize efficiency.
Ensure continued compliance of effluent treatment systems with regulatory standards.
Biodiversity: Develop green belts around manufacturing site or allocated land/sites with native tree plantations.
Collaborate with local environmental organizations to support habitat conservation.
Product Use: Provide guidance to users on responsible and efficient product use to reduce environmental impact.
Collect feedback from customers to improve product sustainability and safe usage.
Promote practices that reduce emissions, resource use, and waste during product application.
Product End-of-Life: Enable recycling and recovery of products and packaging wherever possible.
Ensure safe disposal of expired or off-spec chemicals through authorized services.
Encourage customers to return packaging for reuse or recycling.
Track end-of-life product management to improve circular economy practices.
Customer Health & Safety: Ensure all products comply with global and local safety regulations before release.
Maintain and update labeling, hazard communication, and SDS for regulatory compliance.
Monitor and review product safety performance to identify improvements in handling and usage.
Conduct targeted training for customers on safe handling practices and emergency response.
Employee Awareness & Engagement: Conduct periodic environmental awareness and compliance training for employees relevant to their roles and operations.
Integrate environmental responsibilities into SOPs and daily work practices to reinforce sustainable behavior.
Environmental Services & Advocacy: Conduct employee training on environmental responsibility and sustainable practices.
Engage suppliers in environmentally responsible procurement and operations.
Support local environmental initiatives and sustainability programs.

targets.target: Increase the use of renewable energy to 30% of total energy consumption
Reduce total energy consumption by 15%
Achieve total reduction of Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions by 15%
Achieve a 30% reduction in air pollutant emissions compared to FY 2022–23
Maintain 100% compliance with national ambient air quality standards for indoor and outdoor emissions
Reduce diesel vehicle use by 15%
Recover and reuse 95% of solvents used in batch processes
Reduce process waste and material losses by 10%
Reduce water consumption across operations by 30%
Reduce process water losses (Leakages, overflows, Blowdown) by 80%
Plant and maintain 3000 native trees around processing facilities
Implement 2 habitat restoration projects in collaboration with community and environmental partners
Life cycle measurement to be done of 100% key specialty chemical products
Ensure 100% of products are supplied with clear usage instructions and environmental handling guidance
Increase the use of recycled and repurposed materials to 50% in product formulations, intermediates packaging and bulk containers
Ensure provision for 100% safe disposal of expired or off-spec products through authorized waste management facilities
Conduct 2 customer safety awareness or communication initiative annually for key products
Ensure 100% of products have accurate labeling, hazard communication, and up-to-date Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
Achieve 100% employee coverage under environmental, health, and safety training annually
Conduct 3 employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability or environmental performance
Allocate 1% of annual profits toward community and environmental stewardship initiatives
Train 80% of key suppliers on sustainability practices and environmental management

responsibilities.duty: Oversees implementation and monitoring of the Environmental Policy, ensures regulatory compliance, leads training, and coordinates environmental reporting.
Integrate environmental goals into departmental functions, collaborate with the EHS Manager, and implement initiatives such as waste reduction, water conservation, and energy efficiency.
Follow environmental guidelines, participate in sustainability initiatives, and adopt best practices to support Yash Speciality Chemicals’ sustainability objectives.
Support sustainability efforts through partnerships and compliance with environmental standards.

policy.monitoring: Yash Speciality Chemicals LLP continuously monitors its environmental performance across key areas, including energy use, greenhouse gas emissions, water management, waste reduction, and product safety. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are defined for each area and tracked through internal systems to measure progress against sustainability targets. Performance is reviewed quarterly, with findings consolidated for senior management to guide strategic decisions. Annual assessments evaluate achievements, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions, while relevant outcomes are communicated to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting are conducted in line with regulatory requirements and industry best practices to maintain accuracy and credibility.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed once in every three years, or earlier if required by the EHS Manager and updated as necessary to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and internal environmental goals. Updates will be communicated to all stakeholders to ensure consistent application and engagements. Necessary revisions will be made to strengthen environmental commitments and drive continuous improvement. Any significant changes or updates will be communicated to all employees and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
